exposure: mild (grades 1-2) vs severe (grade 3, periventricular hemorrhagic infarct) vs no intraventricular hemorrhage
cohort: 455 infants with birth weight <1000 grams who had transfontanel ultrasounds in the first week of life
finding: Inotrope-required hypotension is the strongest predisposing factor for high-grade ventricular hemorrhage in extremely low birth weight infants.
